name: Post Office Savings Account (POSB / SB)

conventions.payout: Credited annually; first Rs 10,000 interest/year exempt under Sec 80TTA
conventions.depositLimitCurrent: Min Rs 500 to open (Rs 50 minimum balance for non-cheque accounts per current rules); no maximum balance limit
conventions.administeredBy: DEA / National Savings Institute; India Post and IPPB

currentQuarter.nextAnnouncement: Q3 FY2026-27 (Oct-Dec 2026) not yet announced as of 2026-09-27; expect DEA OM ~2026-09-30, though POSB has not moved off 4.0% since Dec 2011.

periods.note: Flat 3.5% for over four decades. Secondary-sourced for the full span (potoolsblog.in/saposts.com); the rate is widely corroborated across many compilations with no disagreement found.
Raised to 4.0% w.e.f. 1 Dec 2011 and unchanged in every quarterly DEA notification since, including through Q2 FY2026-27 (confirmed by NSI master table 132 and India Post's current-rates page).

gaps: The full 1968-2011 flat-3.5% span rests on secondary compilations only; a primary Gazette/DEA confirmation of the exact 1968 launch rate was not independently located in this pass, though multiple secondary sources agree without exception.
notes: Simplest rate history of any scheme covered: only one change (3.5% to 4.0%) in 43+ years.
